title: Crestline Fleet Account Tire Volume Credit
content:
A tire volume credit is added to the pricing correction on a Crestline Fleet Account tire invoice posted with no fleet discount; it follows how many tire invoices the account has carried.

| Tire invoices posted to the account less than twelve whole months before today | Tire volume credit |
|---|---|
| ten or more | 20.00 |
| five to nine | 10.00 |
| fewer than five | nothing |

Every fleet invoice in the tires service category with an invoice date less than twelve whole months before today is counted, the corrected invoice included when its date falls in that period.

## Boundaries

- 4 tire invoices: none; 5: 10.00.
- 9 tire invoices: 10.00; 10: 20.00.

## Where the amount sits

Because a fleet invoice posted without the program discount is Crestline's billing error, make-good amounts are added to the pricing correction on a tire invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all. The correction starts from the restored discount (the fleet discount the ticket should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried). The limit of the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice is applied last, after every make-good amount, and prevails over every other part of the correction rule, so a correction can fall below the restored discount only when that limit is lower; the correction is rounded half up to the cent once, after the limit.
